prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: complete rasterized presentation slide
Primary request: create one polished 16:9 Chinese presentation slide for the role "cover".
Communication purpose: 建立主题和核心判断
Single claim: AI 原生知识工作流
Audience: 产品团队、知识工作者与组织管理者
Art direction: cinematic technology keynote, engineered and credible rather than science-fiction fantasy
Composition/framing: dark stage, strong left-to-right information flow, one luminous technical visual, clear focal hierarchy
Color palette: near-black teal, cool white, electric cyan, small warm amber signal
Typography: precise geometric Chinese sans serif with occasional monospace micro labels
Imagery: abstract data infrastructure, systems, light paths, or engineered macro photography. Page-specific visual brief: 城市、网络与知识流动形成的克制视觉意象
Material classification: image; use the matching visual representation and do not invent factual content.
Continuity anchor: launch-tech-anchor; continuity group: launch-tech-deck.
Materials/textures: dark glass, fine technical lines, restrained luminous edges
Theme consistency anchors: short cyan calibration line; subtle engineering grid; single amber progress mark
Text (verbatim, 文字必须逐字准确、顺序一致、每条只出现一次):
1. "AI 原生知识工作流"
2. "把散落信息变成持续可用的判断"
Constraints: render the complete slide as a single finished image; readable from a projector; strong hierarchy; generous whitespace; no editable UI; no watermark（无水印）; no logo.
Avoid: purple gaming neon; hologram clichés; dense circuit-board wallpaper; cyberpunk characters; 不得添加任何其他文字; 乱码; 伪造数据; dense card grid; tiny labels.
